COMPLETION EVIDENCE for the three criteria the verifier could not confirm (its evidence report truncated mid-sentence on each). All re-run at the MERGED commit bd8dc713f, not the pre-rebase sha.

1) 'The criterion is exercised end to end through the Pass-1 single-turn chunk path against a FakeRunner'
   tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_reaches_pass1_and_attributes -> PASSED.
   The test drives passes.pass1_chunk with a capturing runner, asserts the criterion id and the word
   'quantif' appear in the finder instructions actually sent (proving the rubric reached the call), and
   asserts the emitted finding survives criterion-attribution validation as [['ac-satisfiability']] —
   attribution drops out-of-set tags, so a mis-registered id would vanish there.

2) 'docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md parity-checks clean against the registry'
   registry.validate_criteria_guide('<checkout>') -> []   (empty list = clean parity)
   registry.validate_packaged_routing()          -> []
   The guide contains the '## ac-satisfiability' section at line 517.
   Also asserted by tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py::test_explain_returns_section -> PASSED.

3) 'make lint, make typecheck and pytest tests/unit all pass'
   make lint      -> ruff check + format-check pass; zizmor 'No findings to report'; actionlint clean.
   make typecheck -> 'Success: no issues found in 389 source files'
   pytest tests/unit -> 5801 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed (768s).
   These also ran inside the pre-commit hook at commit time and passed there independently.

All 20 new tests pass across tests/unit/test_ac_satisfiability_criterion.py (9) and
tests/unit/test_container_roster.py (11).

Gerrit change 1021 merged as bd8dc713f with LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 3 advisory, non-blocking) and
Verified +1 (CI run 30510156790 SUCCESS).
